basic.title: Basic
basic.hint: The project's colour and the AI context handed to every agent working on it.

color.label: Color
color.hint: An Ivy colour name, as config.yaml stores it.

context.label: Context
context.placeholder: What an agent should know about this project...

repositories.title: Repositories
repositories.hint: Source repositories, and the base branch each plan branches from.

remove.consequence: The checkout on disk is untouched — this only stops new plans for this project from being based on it.

repositories.note: A remote URL is cloned into TENDRIL_HOME, and the row shows where it was cloned to rather than the URL; a local path is stored as typed.

reviewActions.title: Review Actions
reviewActions.hint: Quick-launch buttons shown during review to preview or run the app.
reviewActions.empty: No review actions for this project.

removal.consequence: It stops being offered on this project's plans in Review, and the remaining actions close up around its place in the run order.

verifications.title: Verifications
verifications.hint: Quality checks required before plans are marked complete. Drag to set the run order.
verifications.empty: No verifications are defined in config.yaml, so there is nothing to enable. Add one to create it and enable it here.

ports.title: Ports
ports.hint: Named service ports. A plan falls back to a free port when the default is taken.
ports.empty: No service ports configured. Define named ports for dynamic port allocation across concurrent plan reviews.
ports.mergeLimitation: Ports are a mapping, and PUT /api/config deep-merges mappings, so a port can be added or changed here but not removed or renamed.

envFiles.title: Environment Files
envFiles.hint: Files recreated inside every plan worktree, which starts without untracked .env files.
envFiles.empty: No environment files configured. Define environment files to materialize .env templates and inject variables into plan worktrees.

removal.consequence: Its variables stop being injected into new plan worktrees. Files already materialized in existing worktrees stay as they are.

security.title: Security
security.hint: Sandboxing, file and network rules, and terminal confirmation, for this project.

preset.label: Security Preset
preset.hint: Anything other than Custom overrides the sandbox and file/network fields below.

sandboxMode.label: Sandbox Mode
sandboxMode.hint: Inherit General means no sandbox. Effective: {{effective}}.

outsideFileAccess.label: Outside File Access
outsideFileAccess.hint: Deny drops every file rule below. Effective: {{effective}}.

terminalAutoExecution.label: Terminal Auto-Execution
terminalAutoExecution.hint: Not affected by the preset. Effective: {{effective}}.

filePermissions.label: File Permissions
filePermissions.hint: One `{{syntax}}` per line. {{allow}} adds a writable directory; {{deny}} denies {{write}} and {{edit}} on the path.

networkRules.label: Network Access Rules
networkRules.hintAllowed: One `{{syntax}}` per line. A single {{deny}} turns network access off entirely. Effective: allowed.
networkRules.hintDenied: One `{{syntax}}` per line. A single {{deny}} turns network access off entirely. Effective: denied.

allowedCommands.label: Allowed Terminal Commands
allowedCommands.hint: One command per line, each allowed as `{{syntax}}`.

enforcement.ignored: Ignored by {{agent}}: {{controls, list(style: narrow)}}. Those keys are still written and honoured by agents that support them.

mcpServers.title: Local Permissions
mcpServers.hint: Custom Model Context Protocol servers for this project.
mcpServers.empty: No MCP servers configured for this project.

removal.consequence: Agents working on this project stop being given its tools. This removes the project's reference to it, not the server definition itself.

skills.title: Customizations
skills.hint: Custom skills and prompt instructions for agents working on this project.
skills.empty: No custom skills configured for this project.

removal.consequence: Agents working on this project stop being given it. This removes the project's reference to it, not the skill's own files.

skills.memoryNote: Project memories live as markdown files under {{path}}. The daemon exposes no route for them, so they cannot be edited here yet.

remove.description: Removes the project from config.yaml. Cloned repositories, plan folders and history are left on disk, so adding the project back by name restores it.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the project's plans, its cloned repositories under {{path}}, its database rows and its config entry. This cannot be undone, and asks you to type the project name first.

arguments.label: Arguments
arguments.hint: Split on whitespace, the way EditMcpServerBladeView splits them.

name.label: Name
name.hint: Port identifier referenced in environment overrides via {{placeholder}} placeholders.

defaultPort.label: Default Port
defaultPort.invalid: Default Port must be between 1 and 65535.
defaultPort.hint: Preferred port. If it is already taken, Tendril allocates a free one instead.

path.label: Path
path.hint: Relative path to the environment file recreated inside the plan worktree.

template.label: Template
template.hint: Optional base template copied into the worktree before overrides are applied.
